fieldSources.quoted: Value appears verbatim within the record's quoted span on its page.
fieldSources.derived: Computed by code from verified quoted fields with a named primitive; never emitted by the model.
fieldSources.classified: Model chooses from the field's enum based on quoted text; shown as a labelled, correctable choice.

unclassifiedPolicy: Unknown documents are read with the generic checklist, never forced into a type, and never counted toward requirements.

requirements.sourcePolicy: Every rule carries citation, jurisdiction, source effective date and applicability. State rules are not included.
requirements.uploadPolicy: No upload is required. Plan-content rules run only when an iep.plan is supplied; otherwise they are not_applicable and the screen says no plan was supplied.

rules.description: Present levels, including how the disability affects involvement and progress in the general curriculum.
Measurable annual goals, academic and functional.
Benchmarks or short-term objectives for children taking alternate assessments.
How progress toward each goal is measured and when periodic reports are provided.
Services, aids and modifications, with projected start date, frequency, location and duration.
Explanation of the extent the child will not participate with nondisabled children.
Accommodations for state and districtwide assessments, or why an alternate assessment is appropriate.
Why the child cannot participate in the regular assessment and why the alternate is appropriate.
From the first IEP in effect when the child turns 16 (earlier if the team decides; some states start earlier).
Statement that rights transfer at the age of majority, at least one year before; needs the state age-of-majority table.
Prior written notice describes the action, why, the evaluation basis, other options considered and other factors.

insightChecks.policy: Each check compares verified, keyed facts with an engine primitive and yields a question with chips on both sides. Engine defaults (change, conflict, series, missing) are not repeated here.

checks.question: The goal's baseline is {left}; {rightDocument} shows {right} for the same measure. Which is current?
{presentDocument} describes a need in {area}. No goal in that area appears in the current plan. Was it discussed?
There is a goal in {area}, but present levels do not describe {area}. Where does the baseline come from?
{service} went from {before} to {after} minutes a week while progress in {area} was reported as {status}. What was the reason for the change?
Goals say progress is reported {frequency}. Reports were supplied for {covered} of {expected} periods. Are the others available?
{accommodation} is listed for testing but not under state or district assessment participation. Should it be?
How do the measurements since the baseline compare with the target of {target}?
The most recent evaluation supplied is dated {date}, more than three years ago. Is a reevaluation scheduled, or was it agreed to be unnecessary?

byRecordType.present_level: Where your child is now, in words and numbers, and how it affects learning in the regular classroom.
byRecordType.goal: What the school plans for your child to learn in a year, how it will be measured, and the starting point (baseline).
byRecordType.short_term_objective: Smaller steps toward an annual goal, required when your child takes an alternate state test.
byRecordType.service: The help the school provides: what it is, how often, for how long each time, where, and from when to when.
byRecordType.accommodation: Changes to how your child learns or is tested, such as extra time. They change how, not what, your child learns.
byRecordType.placement: How much of the day your child spends with students without disabilities, and why any time is spent apart.
byRecordType.assessment_participation: How your child takes state and district tests, and any changes allowed during them.
byRecordType.transition: Plans for life after high school: training or education, work, and independent living. Required from the IEP in effect at age 16.
byRecordType.progress_entry: The school's report on how your child is doing on each goal for a period.
byRecordType.amendment_change: A change to the existing IEP made without writing a new one. The rest of the IEP stays in effect.
byRecordType.school_action: The school's written notice of something it proposes or refuses to do, and why.
byRecordType.eligibility: The decision about whether your child qualifies for special education, and under which category.

readingNotes.global: Extract every record in this document type's checklist, including repeats. One table row or one goal is one record. Quote the source text that holds the record; every quoted field value must appear in that quote. Do not infer absent numbers, identities, relationships or legal conclusions. Report a labelled but empty field as field_present_but_empty, citing the label. Distinguish what is observed, planned and decided.

byDocumentType.iep.plan: Session length is not duration: '30 minutes, 2 times a week' is minutes per session and sessions per period; duration is start and end dates. When a service states an explicit total such as '150 minutes weekly', put that phrase in frequency_text; do not split it into minutes per session. Quote each service row whole. Keep the meeting date and the IEP start date apart. In present levels, one measurement per score with its measure fields; never merge accuracy percentages with words correct per minute. Split a goal's target value and accuracy criterion into separate fields. Record Oral Reading Fluency and reading fluency as the task reading fluency.
byDocumentType.iep.amendment: Record the date of the IEP being amended. Extract only the records the amendment changes or adds, plus one amendment_change per affected section.
byDocumentType.iep.progress: One progress_entry per goal per reporting period. Quote progress codes as written and choose the status code from the list. Emit each reported score as a measurement with context progress_report.
byDocumentType.iep.evaluation.academic: One measurement per reported score, with instrument, subtest as task, and score type. Record the administration date.
byDocumentType.iep.evaluation.psychoeducational: One measurement per index or subtest score. Composite and subtest scores are separate measurements.
byDocumentType.iep.evaluation.speech_language: One measurement per subtest or index score; record the instrument and score type.
byDocumentType.iep.evaluation.independent: Same as other evaluations. Do not judge agreement with district results; code compares them.
byDocumentType.iep.notice: One school_action per action. Keep 'proposes' and 'refuses' as the decision; quote the reasons and options considered as written.
byDocumentType.parent.correspondence: One parent_request per distinct request. Quote the request as written; record any response only if it is in this document.

vocabulary.note: Starter set. The existing repository vocabulary remains authoritative and must be merged before runtime use.

abbreviations.PLAAFP: present levels of academic achievement and functional performance

definitions.definition: How long a service runs, from its start date to its end date. Not the length of one session.
Where a service is delivered, such as the special education classroom. Different from placement.
How much of the day a child spends with peers without disabilities, and the setting overall.
The starting measurement in a goal. Not the most recent score.
A change to the existing IEP. A new IEP replaces the old one; an amendment does not.
Movement toward an annual goal as reported by the school. Not a grade.
A change in how a child learns or is tested, not in what is expected.
A change in what a child is expected to learn or demonstrate.
A free public education designed to meet the child's individual needs.

referenceTables.policy: Every entry needs source, jurisdiction, effective date and owner (law, agency or user). Code applies them; the model never quotes them from memory.

entries.note: Federal floor is the IEP in effect at 16; some states start earlier.
Only needed to derive time in general education when the plan does not state it.

changeLog: 0.3.1-proposed: accommodation context split; need_identified + need_without_goal where-filter; readerLegacyContextMap.
changeLogFromV0_2: Fact types are records with fields (previously 92 single-field types); one table row or goal is one record with one quote.
Identity keys are content fields; plan and document are the version axis, not part of the key.
One shared measure construct across measurement, goal and progress records; measurement is a single record type for all scores.
Author roles map to parties (school, independent, parent) so change and conflict are distinguishable.
Added independent evaluation and parent correspondence document types; every document type declares its ordering date.
Added records for transition, assessment participation, transfer of rights, ESY, short-term objectives; service category added and used in the key.
Added classified field source; status codes, score types, categories and author role are classified.
Federal content requirements loaded from 34 CFR 300.320 and 300.503(b), cited and pending legal review; uploads remain unrequired.
Insight checks rewritten as declarative comparisons; engine-default change check removed; seven IEP checks added.
Reading notes per document type, explainers per record type, expanded vocabulary with definitions of easily confused terms, two state reference tables declared.
